# Copenhagen Living

> > Modern Scandinavian furniture retailer offering Copenhagen Imports collections, Stressless comfort solutions, and Italian design pieces across Arizona and Texas showrooms.

Copenhagen Living specializes in contemporary European furniture with an emphasis on Danish design principles, featuring the Essentials Collection, power motion recliners, bedroom sets, and designer lighting. The company operates showrooms in Arizona and Texas, providing personalized service and curated collections for modern living spaces.
